title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to check whether the current user has only the Microsoft 365 Plan in AL
summary: Detect whether a Business Central user has only a Microsoft 365 license by querying the Users In Plans table and checking the Plan ID. This helps apply custom logic or UI changes based on license type, useful since Microsoft 365 plan users can access BC in Teams but encounter errors when accessing directly.
key_points: Users with only Microsoft 365 licenses can access Business Central through Microsoft Teams but not directly
Use the Users In Plans query filtered by User Security ID to determine license type
Check if the user's Plan ID matches the Microsoft 365 Plan ID from the Plan Ids codeunit
The example page extension demonstrates how to show different messages based on license type
Licensing is important for cost optimization and data governance in multi-license scenarios
